answers.core: This is an integral part of GDScript, it cannot be implemented as an add-on.
answers.workaround: As mentioned before, it can be worked around but it's cumbersome and makes for a confusing use of the `continue` keyword. Many users don't know about this usage and trip when trying to use the keyword for the loop inside a `match` statement.

title: Add guards to match patterns in GDScript
